dataLayerPolicy.typescriptSources: The reviewed application catalog is canonical. Generated JSON, JSONL, CSV and diagnostic index are materialized from the same catalog used by the app.
dataLayerPolicy.sourceErrata: Known source errata and taxonomy corrections are normalized before app use and export.
dataLayerPolicy.complexLabels: Pythium, Fusarium and Sclerotinia remain syndrome/complex labels where visual evidence cannot reliably resolve species; new literature augments those profiles instead of creating false species-level image classes.
dataLayerPolicy.referenceBinaries: Twenty-five rights-cleared original references and sixty-six source-grouped panel derivatives remain reference evidence, not supervised model ground truth.
dataLayerPolicy.trainingGate: Supervised Cannabis training remains blocked until independent samples pass rights, confirmation, source-group, duplicate and coverage gates.

limitations: The 61-profile diagnostic knowledge release is triple-verified, but the image corpus is still not statistically sufficient for supervised Cannabis diagnosis training.
Ninety-one source-controlled reference images are evidence/context images, not 91 independent training samples; many are related scientific panels and must stay source-grouped.
No current sample is trainingEligible; train/validation/test/holdout splits remain intentionally empty.
Many pathogen and root-disease labels require organism-level or analytical confirmation for high confidence.
New insect profiles require organism evidence because feeding damage alone is generally not species-specific.
